observed.failure: ds4: failed to open lock file /run/dsv4/inference.lock: Permission denied

diagnosis: The controller selected the inaccessible legacy lock. The installed global inference lock is /run/lock/frontier-at-home/inference.lock and carries an explicit bmarti44 read/write ACL.
bounded_fix: Change only DS4_LOCK_FILE in the candidate-8 controller and its acceptance fixture to the installed ACL-authorized global lock, then rerun the same non-held-out authenticated-runtime smoke.
